description_en: Queries a list of IP address whitelists for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBClusterAccessWhiteList接口查看集群的IP白名单
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-access-white-list --db-cluster-id am-uf6wjk5xxxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterAccessWhiteList

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看指定AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

DBClusterIPArrayAttribute.description_en:
The attribute of the IP address whitelist. By default, this parameter is empty.

The IP address whitelists that have the hidden attribute are not displayed in the console. These IP address whitelists are used to access services such as Data Transmission Service (DTS) and PolarDB-X
DBClusterIPArrayAttribute.description_zh:
白名单分组属性，默认为空。

控制台不显示带有hidden属性的分组，带有该标签的分组通常是用于访问DTS、DRDS服务的

DBClusterIPArrayName.description_en:
The name of the IP address whitelist.

The name of an IP address whitelist must be 2 to 32 characters in length. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
Each cluster supports up to 50 IP address whitelists
DBClusterIPArrayName.description_zh:
IP白名单分组名称。
IP白名单分组名称以小写字母开头、以数字或小写字母结尾，可包含小写字母、数字及’_’，长度为2~32。
单个集群最多支持50个白名单分组

SecurityIPList.description_en: The IP addresses in the IP address whitelist. Up to 1,000 IP addresses can be returned. Multiple IP addresses are separated by commas (,)
SecurityIPList.description_zh: IP白名单分组下的IP列表，最多1000个，以英文逗号（,）隔开
